subject: Re: FVD status: variance study + memory risk
body:
Team,

Locking the calibration sweep plan: 4 model families x 3 seeds x 2048 videos per side, running in our vulcan-h100 week of Jun 8 on the 256-accelerator reservation. Quentin's chunked embedding path is the default.

Decision: 2048 videos per side is the portfolio standard from here on; any FVD number reported at launch review below that sample size gets flagged.

Note the vulcan maintenance window Jun 22-24 lands after our week, so no exposure there, but do not let the sweep slip — there is no second reservation this quarter.

Results readout Jun 16, invite to follow.

Lucia
